proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.duration_override
proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants Scrying and Detect Thoughts through an existing magic-item spell-access pattern, but the Detect Thoughts grant changes the spell's maintenance rules: it does not require concentration and its duration is cut short when the linked Scrying ends. The current surface can express fixed DC and spell-sensor targeting, but not a grant-scoped duration/lifecycle override.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You don't need to concentrate on this Detect Thoughts spell to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if the Scrying spell ends.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall. The unit fits magic_item + passive structurally, and existing surface shapes already cover grant_spell_access, fixed DC 17, and targeting creatures within 30 feet of the spell's sensor. The honest blocker is a missing grant-scoped duration/lifecycle override for the Detect Thoughts cast.
